purpose: Observe BTC and ETH spot and market-regime behavior around the 2026-10-28 FOMC and 2026-11-03 US midterm elections; test whether event-aware information adds explanatory or predictive value beyond matched regimes. Do not infer causality from temporal coincidence.

factual_event_sources.timing: scheduled, not yet published as of registration
election day, not the date when all results become final

baselines.reporting_rule: Do not report future horizons until mature; event return uses last eligible completed 1h spot close pre-anchor and fixed eligible closes after t0. Separate cash-market session returns and 24/7 crypto returns; do not create synthetic weekend stock prices.
baselines.price_sources: Primary exchange spot OHLCV with source, venue, time, retrieval, hash and gaps; prices.json systemPrice may be used only when actually fresh, never backfilled as if live.
baselines.macro_surprise: Actual FOMC decision, statement and forward-guidance surprise must be evaluated against a dated, as-of-pre-publication expectation, not classified using future market reaction.

comparator.rule: Enumerate all eligible prior midterm events with verified BTC data and contemporaneous FOMC proximity; compare against pre-specified time-matched non-election controls in the same UP/TRANSITION/SIDEWAYS/DOWN regime, similar volatility and macro conditions. Keep all negative episodes.
comparator.warning: Only three prior midterms with mature BTC coverage; no confident probability/causality claims, no in-sample tuning passed off as out-of-sample.
comparator.event_dependency: 2026 FOMC and election are six days apart; 7/14/30/90-day windows overlap and must be treated as one dependent event cluster, not independent votes.

handoffs.P1: Describe event window and independent market regime evidence with limitations.
handoffs.P2: Read-only candidate comparison for early entry, post-FOMC entry and post-election confirmation after real information availability; BTC and ETH separately, fees/slippage/MAE/MFE; current LONG PAPER unchanged.
handoffs.P3: BTC72H is external shadow risk context only; frozen model, checkpoint and baseline unchanged.

writeback_boundary: This registration is a stand-alone research-branch sidecar; it does not by itself update Project Sources, CURRENT_MANIFEST, the separate program registry, GitHub main, scheduled workflows, or financial books.
